en.headline: Aviation department follows up fireworks drone footage
en.dek: The Civil Aviation Department said it is handling a case under its usual procedures after footage appeared to show a drone over Victoria Harbour on National Day.
body: The Civil Aviation Department said on Monday night that it was following its established procedures in a case involving drone footage of the National Day fireworks. The department did not say that anyone had been charged.

Local reports said a video circulating online appeared to show a small drone being prepared on Hong Kong Island and later aerial views of the fireworks display over Victoria Harbour. Online commenters questioned whether the flight had taken place inside a restricted flying zone. The Peak, the harbour and the shoreline are marked as restricted flying zones on the department's site.

The department said operators of small unmanned aircraft must meet the requirements of the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order. Flying beyond the standard operating rules, or inside a restricted flying zone, is an advanced operation and needs prior permission from the department or the relevant authority.

It said a person convicted under the order can be fined up to HK$100,000 and jailed for up to two years. The department said it would keep working with police on publicity and on enforcement, including follow-up of individual cases.

zh.headline: 民航處跟進疑在維港拍國慶煙花的無人機片段
zh.dek: 民航處說正按既定程序跟進個案，並重申在限制飛行區操作小型無人機屬進階操作，須事先獲許可。
body: 民航處星期一晚回覆查詢時表示，正按既定程序跟進一宗涉及無人機拍攝國慶煙花的個案。處方沒有表示已有人被檢控。
本地報道指，網上片段看來顯示有人在港島一帶準備小型無人機，其後出現俯瞰維多利亞港國慶煙花的畫面。網民質疑飛行是否在限制飛行區內進行。民航處網站把扯旗山山頂、維港上空及岸邊一帶列為限制飛行區。
民航處說，操作小型無人機必須符合《小型無人機令》的規管要求和操作規定。若活動超出標準操作規定，或在限制飛行區內操作，即屬進階操作，必須事先獲得民航處或有關當局許可。
處方指出，觸犯《小型無人機令》一經定罪，最高可被罰款10萬元及監禁兩年。民航處說會繼續與警方合作加強宣傳，並透過跟進個案等方式執行該命令。
